connector.name: Operandi
connector.registryDescription: Grounded, safety-checked appliance operation packages for robots and agents. Zero-config trial.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package operandi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace cc.operandi. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPERANDI_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the OPERANDI API (default https://api.operandi.cc; use your hosted URL in prod).

env.name: OPERANDI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional: your OPERANDI key. Leave unset for a zero-config instant trial (the server mints + caches its own key, 2 packages included).
